name: Hair Stylist
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve exact dark-skinned stylist, slick pompadour, gray/cream open-collar jumpsuit, belt, loop-handled styling tools, belt dryer and bare feet. Avoid invented gender traits or weapons. Review wig continuity, feet, cords and cyan keying.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Hair Stylist — Blowout.
IDENTITY: the exact dark-skinned adult stylist in the reference: sharply swept glossy black pompadour with short sides, precise brows, dark rose lips, fitted charcoal-gray and cream open-collar jumpsuit, brown belt with square gold buckle, bare feet, two black loop-handled electric styling tools with purple details and a black belt-hung hair dryer. Preserve exact face, body, costume and tool designs. These are hair tools, never guns or weapons.
0–0.7s: full-body confident stance, the two smaller styling tools secured at the belt. The stylist draws the black dryer in one smooth theatrical flourish and gives a severe appraisal to a small tangled black wig on a plain cream display head floating nearby. The display head is an inanimate unpainted salon prop, not another person.
0.7–2.5s: the dryer starts with a furious turbine growl; camera whips backward to reveal the wig expanding into an ENORMOUS thirty-foot knot of solid black ink-outlined hair. The stylist twists the dryer upward and unleashes one gigantic ivory-and-gold corkscrew air blast. Camera spirals alongside the blast as it combs through the massive knot, throwing finite warm-gray dust clumps away and pulling the hair into one dramatic glossy sculpted curl. A thunderous final pressure SNAP sends a huge warm-white/gold starburst around the immaculate curl. Broad cyan gaps around hair, air strokes and body; no salon, floor, mirror, background panel or translucent blue wind.
2.5–3.5s: camera snaps back toward the stylist's perfectly controlled face. The spectacular curl shrinks into a beautifully styled normal wig on the cream display head. Exact title BLOWOUT slams below the face in one large stable comic word, with black outline and dark extrusion.
3.5–5s: the stylist holsters the dryer with effortless attitude, then notices one tiny stray hair standing on their own pompadour. One precise finger smooths it instantly; a satisfied raised eyebrow finishes the pose. Keep full body and bare feet visible, clean cyan margin and stable title. SFX: tool draw click, fierce turbine windup, immense corkscrew air roar, sharp pressure SNAP, dryer shutdown and tiny polished finger-swipe sound. No speech, music or narration.
